storyInfo: Lada's mother, Alita, discovers that the First Army is using the Infected to supply energy to the Sarcophagus. Disillusioned, she sacrifices herself and entrusts the Sarcophagus to Rhodes Island, but the Rhodes Island discovers the Sarcophagus in a destroyed state. The Fourth Army crosses the front line and marches upon Zelgrad.

attributes.content: <p=1>Lab Six, Zelgrad Sealed District Laboratory</><p=2>Jan 18, 1102, 23:07</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: You've been looking at these files for an entire day, director. You should get some rest, at least eat something...
attributes.name: Worried Researcher

attributes.content: Is this all of the Kushkina file, Gira?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I think... like you, though, I was recently reassigned, so I can't be sure there are no omissions.
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: I wasn't even given a logbook during the handover.
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: All research data should be filed in the logbook, whether the data is valid or not. This is a problem.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Look at this. The progress reports jump straight from 03 to 21, the missing files listed as 'data lost'. Not even the raw records remain.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: And these audio logs have clearly been tampered with. I took some time to listen to them, but there was nothing but useless noise.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: This is not normal. When I went to the security station to obtain security footage of Lab Six from prior to the handover, I found that all footage from the last three days have been deleted.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: All that they gave me were some maintenance logs. They said it provided a record of people come to and from Lab Six during these few days.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Guess what I found.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Beats me.
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: On the day of the Kushkina test, there was a power outage that lasted about thirty minutes. The repair team arrived eight minutes after the outage began, but they were not able to fully mitigate the overload problem.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Following up on the trail, I found that the cooling pool had dried up that day, and all backup systems were destroyed, while the temperature of that thing underground remains at high levels—
attributes.name: Alita
Alita
attributes.content: It's not going to blow up immediately, but things didn't go back to normal either.

attributes.name: Alita
attributes.content: This means there's something else that's cooling it, but we don't know what it is!
Even so, the conclusion in the report was that risk levels were under control.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: But the test succeed. The power of Kushkina was witnessed across half of Ursus...
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: Is that really something worth celebrating?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: My research was on how to turn the 'Prototype' into a reliable energy source, not an uncontrollable weapon.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: But all we know about Kushkina is that it's powerful, and it cannot be recreated in a controlled environment.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I don't even want to think about where these experiments are going.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Director... couldn't we just focus on doing experiments? If you question the Marshal's decisions—
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: I'm in no position to defy my orders...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: But I need to find out what's going on in this place.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: HR records... six from the data team, two from the risk assessment team, seven from the assembly team.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Reassignment... promotion... none of them are in Zelgrad anymore.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I can't reach any of them...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: What are you looking for at an hour like this?
attributes.name: Curious Researcher

attributes.content: Something like notes from the previous supervisor. We ran into a roadblock during the day—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Well, if it's not here, it's probably not anywhere. The whole Lab Six staff was replaced. Surely you know what that means in this industry.
attributes.name: Curious Researcher

attributes.content: What are you saying?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: They must have screwed up somewhere, which means the previous supervisor would be held responsible, which means she wouldn't have left any notes behind.
attributes.name: Curious Researcher

attributes.content: We have to empty our pockets when we leave the building. If she really left, she wouldn't have been able to take anything associated with the project.
attributes.name: Curious Researcher

attributes.content: If you can't find it here, you won't find it anywhere.
attributes.name: Curious Researcher

attributes.content: Director?
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: Gira? What is it?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I thought about what you said and decided you should have this. It contains some unlogged notes that I found in a cabinet.
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: I didn't open them, but—I hope they can help you and the project.
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: Thank you, Gira...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Don't mention it, really!
attributes.name: Gira

attributes.content: Diary... blank scrap paper...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: The signature of the previous supervisor? Did all this belong to her?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: A notebook—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: What is this?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Words of despair are scrawled over the last page.

attributes.text: With what sanity I have left, I believe we will never find out the truth about this machine, not in the lifetime of Ursus.
\n\nIt is so complex and contains such massive energy reserves that I can only consider it a work of God, and it is not our place to use it, either as a weapon or Originium generator.
\n\nIt is a complete black box with no credible theoretical basis on which to study it. Even more terrifying is that it seems to have a mind of its own, resisting our exploration of it.
\n\nThis time, the explosion occurred in the wilderness. Next time, it could happen at Zelgrad, even Grypherburg.
\n\nNo one knows where this instrument came from or what it is, but one thing is clear: It is not a blessing to the empire, but a curse.

attributes.content: There are numerous graphs and diagrams in the notebook.
Some are smooth and clean, neat and tidy, while other peak and bottom out sharply or terminate suddenly. There appears to be little rhyme or reason to the data.
'Experiment outcome is not reproducible in whole or part. The overall state of Project Zero is...'
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Gosudar-batyushka...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: There is no weapon. The successful test was just dumb luck.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: (Hushed) All the 'energy'... they've gone into a bottomless pit.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Director Alita Valueva! The Army—the Generalik just had everyone in Lab Four arrested!
attributes.name: Researcher

attributes.content: Why? What does he want?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: No idea. But they haven't been taken away yet. You should hurry!
attributes.name: Researcher

attributes.content: I—why should I hurry?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Isn't your husband working in Lab Four?
attributes.name: Researcher

attributes.content: Stop.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: I'm the director of Lab Six.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Doesn't matter. You can't pass.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: I am Alita Valueva, director of Lab Six. I am demanding that Lab Four and its personnel be reassigned to the critical project at Lab Six.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Communicate this to your superior immediately.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Don't make me repeat myself again.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: I don't want to repeat myself either—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Do as she says.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: Chief?
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: A chief of staff who has to take orders from a child who hasn't seen a single battle? Who would believe it?
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: Open your eyes, soldier.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: General Anatoliy Svetlanov Buterin, in his infinite wisdom, has instructed that all requests by Lab Six are top-priority, whether it's the old one or the new one.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: Where's the watch your mother gave you?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Lost it.
attributes.name: Haggard Man

attributes.content: Are you still taking your meds?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Not for a long time. I would be kicked out of the lab if they found out.
attributes.name: Haggard Man

attributes.content: I'm not leaving you, Lita.
attributes.name: Haggard Man

attributes.content: Then stop deceiving me, Klim.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I've never...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Your recklessness almost killed everyone in your lab.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Besides, I never told you about my comms channel. How did you find out?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: You were still using the system we built together when we were in school. Only I know about it here...
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Why didn't you ask me?
attributes.name: Alita
Klim
attributes.content: You don't—

attributes.name: Klim
attributes.content: You don't want to see me, do you?
Oh, I'm not trying to blame you—
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I know.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: I know you wanted to see me, but I didn't want to see you. I don't care about anyone who comes and goes in this place, and you need to know that you're the same to me right now.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: The only thing that matters to me right now is completing Kushkina.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Lita—
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: Don't call me that. You should not have joined a project you were unsuited to, just because of me. You should have gone to Lada and stayed with her.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Even a broken family is home.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Home. Yes, Lita! In the last communication, I heard—
attributes.name: Klim

attributes.content: No, don't say it. I don't want to know.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Stay away from the work here. Don't try to send any messages out with my channel.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Go get some cleaning work from Logistics. Stay away from all of this.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: <p=1>3F Corridor, Zelgrad Sealed District Laboratory</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 07:20</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: All of B3 is assigned to Lab Five.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Their work may be more aligned with your company's. Their field of research is the progression of Oripathy infection.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Would you like to take a look?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: No, thank you... there's a question I've mean meaning to ask, Madam Alita Valueva—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Go on.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Do we really have to be accompanied by so many soldiers?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Ah, I forgot to explain.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Visitors must be accompanied by military representatives at all times. I informed them in accordance with regulations.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: To prevent espionage and leaks concerning secret projects. I'm sure you understand.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: ...I understand.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Will they intrude on our conversations?

attributes.content: There is no need to worry. The security measures only come in play when necessary. Otherwise, you can treat them as though they don't exist.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: If you insist, we can stop and develop trust in not having conversations interrupted.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: There's no need—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: For example, I'm curious about the analysis on the 'Prototype' that you provided. How did you know so much?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: 'Prototype'?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: (Whisper) Maybe she means the Sarcophagus. Let the Doctor handle it.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: A Rhodes Island member was involved in its research.
She was an outstanding scientist.;She was an experienced scholar.

attributes.content: How much does this researcher know about the Prototype?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.options: No one knows the Sarcophagus better than her.;She knows everything there is to know about the Sarcophagus.

attributes.content: Sarcophagus... that's a name I haven't heard in a long time. I've gotten used to calling it the Prototype.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Are you familiar with her research?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.options: I have read all the files she left behind.

attributes.content: ...'Left behind', you say. Where did she go?
attributes.name: Alita
Amiya
attributes.content: She...

attributes.name: Amiya
attributes.content: She is temporarily absent from Rhodes Island. That's why she's not with us today.
I suppose you will do. The research has encountered some obstacles, and there are quite a few things in the files that I don't fully understand, for which I could use your help.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: The most pressing issue at present is that the Prototype is in a constant state of overheating and unable to be fully cooled. Certain experiments and operations are unable to be performed, causing the project to grind to a halt.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: No one knows how to stop the overheating and return the Prototype's output to normal boundaries.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: (Whisper) Sounds like the Sarcophagus has entered a protected state after overloading.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Did you say something?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Amiya—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It's alright. You can tell her.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It sounds like the Sarcophagus has entered a protected state after overloading. How long has it been in this state?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Since I took over Lab Six five days ago, maybe even before that.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: That's not right...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: If you would like to know more details, we can go directly to Lab Six.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I won't be letting you go to any other project. You have to stay.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: We can talk on the way.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: ...That's how I was reassigned here.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I first heard about the Sarcophagus when I was a student. It seemed like an urban legend, and young people are always bold and curious—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I wrote a letter to the mayor, a youthful plea that expressed my hope to join research on the Sarcophagus when I grew up. I didn't receive a response, of course.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Who would have thought that I would be studying it here, twenty years later?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Are you from Chernobog?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Heh, yes. I was born in Chernobog, as was my daughter... I hope to be buried there when I die.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Why do you say this—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: How old are you, child?
attributes.name: Alita
Amiya
attributes.content: I'm not really a child anymore...

attributes.name: Amiya
attributes.content: I was sent here as, um, a researcher. I'm not so little anymore.
Your generation will always be children in the eyes of mine. Perhaps one day you'll understand, when you find yourself in our shoes.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I left that place because of my work. I've practically forgotten what my daughter looks like.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Has she grown? What is life like for her? Has she made new friends?
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: All I know is that she's still alive, that she survived the disaster at Chernobog five years ago. Other than that, I know nothing about my proud little girl scout...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I know almost nothing about Lada anymore.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Isolated research project, Chernobog, girl scout, Lada.
Amiya remembers Crownslayer's conjecture in her report to the Grypherburg office.
She looks closely at the woman's golden hair, the shape of her face becoming increasingly familiar.
The conjecture grows more certain by the second, and Amiya could not help but ask.
Could you please repeat your last name?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Valueva.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I know a Lada Valueva. She's around my age, and she's from Chernobog too—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: She was in the Ursus Youth Scouts. She joined Rhodes Island as an operator, and is currently continuing her education in Deity Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Lada has been looking for her parents... I'm thinking you might be her mother?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I don't know.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: But if I am... that's the best news I've heard in ages.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Maybe you can come with us to Grypherburg, once we settle things here.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Maybe I could. Grypherburg isn't too far from Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Lada would be delighted to see you.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Yes. She wouldn't even yell at us.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: She is kind, gentle, a much better daughter than we deserve.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I... I really want to see her again.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Stop, Alita Valueva. You are approaching a top-secret area.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: Until this cold, hard reminder, Amiya did not notice that they have journeyed into the depths of the laboratory.
Indeed, the narrow, curved corridor before them seems to lead to a place that few are allowed to step foot in.
They have been sent by the council to assist. They are not ordinary visitors.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Protocol requires that I seek confirmation from my superiors.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: You should not proceed any further until permission has been granted.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: I am the director of Lab Six, and this is necessary for our operation. You have no idea how much could have been achieved in the time wasted waiting here.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: We are simply following orders.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: What do we do—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Watch your feet. The corridor leading to the observation room is not connected to the central power supply, and emergency lighting could be fickle at the best of times...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: But I'll find it. Give me a moment.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: (Whisper) You'll have less than ten seconds. Do not hesitate.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: (Whisper) If you have any questions, you should ask them now.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Is the Sarcophagus still in a condition to supply energy to Ursus?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Now is not the time to talk about the theoretical future...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Never mind... I trust in your resolve.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Found it.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Amiya...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I put in your hands the fate of Lada, and of millions more.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: This is—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: 'Emergency lighting.'
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Go, Amiya, and take your friends.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: What about you?!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Go—
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: ...Valueva has mutinied.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: Prepare to attack.
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: The emergency lighting comes back in a matter of moments. A closing blast door now separates the scientist and the Rhodes Island team.
Valueva—
attributes.name: Silent Soldier

attributes.content: Alita!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: There is no time! Promise to stop the Sarcophagus! You must do it!
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: It is being fueled by the lives of thousands of kidnapped, dismembered Infected!
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: Too late... it took too long for me to find out. All the research here was designed to reinforce the profit chain of the First Army...
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: I was an accomplice. I can never look Lada in the eye again.
attributes.name: Alita

attributes.content: No! But you—you wanted to see her again!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The door's closing, Amiya! Get your hand clear!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Why—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Why?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.text: ...Perhaps I'm simply tired. Tired of deception, of the passions of love and hate. How could one who has lost the capacity to love go back to those whom she loved?
Fortunately, Lada is not like me. She has always been strong, always true to her word.
She'll miss me, I'm sure. There will be pain and sorrow for her in the future, but there will be even more joy and happiness.

attributes.content: There's no message that I need you to deliver. Let me just...
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: Let me believe it to the end.
attributes.name: Indistinct Voice

attributes.content: A bloody palm mark is painted on the switch, like an immovable seal upon the thick door.
Alita...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Amiya...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Stand up, Amiya.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: This door is thick and jams electrical signals. It's unlikely that those on the outside will be able to force it open in short order.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Alita Valueva has bought us valuable time.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: We have no time to waste.;We can't let her down.

attributes.content: Then...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Let's begin.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: This is the core of the Sarcophagus... I've never seen it with my own eyes.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But something feels off about it...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The megastructure feels both familiar and alien. You still remember its faint silhouette, but what lies before you know is different.
It is not a distant memory. Several years ago, Amiya awakened you from this legacy of a previous civilization, which you sealed away together with Kal'tsit.
More memories come rushing back, mixed with memories buried even deeper.

attributes.text: <color=#000000>Why insist on leaving behind such an inefficient machine, {@nickname}?</color>
<color=#000000>We have more convenient ways of retaining our consciousness... is this part of your obsession with 'life'?</color>
<color=#000000>Coming back to the old argument, are we?</color>
<color=#000000>But of course, I will not deny you such a small liberty... I will add another entry to AMa-10's mission.</color>
<color=#000000>Not satisfied with just touching consciousness? Would you find more comfort to hold my hand like this?</color>
<color=#000000>{@nickname}... I know that you want this, here and now, to be a memory preserved forever.</color>
<color=#000000>Not cast into oblivion, when the ultimate destruction comes.{@nickname}</color>

attributes.content: Doctor!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Are you alright, Doctor? What happened?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: ...Did you see that, Amiya?;I think I remember something...

attributes.content: I saw fragments, snapshots... but nothing clear.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I just felt your pain in that instant...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: I guess... I do have a bit of a headache.
Can you assess the current status of the Sarcophagus, Mon3tr?

attributes.content: Based on my inspection just now...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The Sarcophagus...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: ...has been destroyed.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Chief.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: ...Put him through.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Major Razin, it seems that your progress has fallen behind initial expectations.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You will not arrive at the satellite city in time, at this rate.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: We don't have enough power, Your High Excellency. We're already diverting as much as we can from temperature controls. The men can hardly sleep with the cold...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Though I suppose none of that matters to you.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You are correct.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: In fact, you're not doing enough.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: There's no point in sending an exhausted force to try to steal the weapon for you. We would be easy targets for the First Army.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: It seems you have liberated yourself from your concern for Lieutenant Sirka's safety.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You could have earned Sechin's true loyalty, if you did not hold her life and those of the others hostage.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Anyone can make promises. I only believe what I see. I am not in the habit of trusting someone who has already betrayed me once. Besides, you don't deserve it.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You people do not deserve kindness. I should have learned my lesson sooner.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: We're behind by a day or two, and you act like we've already surrendered to the First Army.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Let me guess what you're planning to do.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: At the next communication, you'll tell me that you've dismissed most of the soldiers from the ship to conserve energy, in order to devote full resources to my mission—
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: I won't, not while Sirka's still at the base—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Then, you will go rogue once the ship has left communications range.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Whether to seize the weapon and use it as leverage to negotiate with me, betray me again and go over to the First Army, or come back alone to attempt an assassination...
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You'll have all the choices in front of you once the Volnov has left my control, and your comrades are safe, won't you?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Did you think I wouldn't know about your foolish plan?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: You poor, pathetic Volnik...
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Has no one told you that this name, which you use to distinguish yourselves from the rest of Ursus, comes from a promise that has never been fulfilled?
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: <p=2>Upper Deck, Flagship of the Fourth Army's main fleet</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Defender Regiments are in position, sir.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Has the vanguard departed the front lines?
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: According to the reports, yes. There has been no alarm from the Second Army's outposts. All is quiet... is this normal?
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: That's not for you to think about.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: Report the ships' positions to Marshal Kuznetsov, and tell him...
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: The Fourth Army is ready—
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: We will advance upon Zelgrad, satellite city of the First Army.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: ...That will do. One more thing. Reserve two hours before the citizen's forum starts. I would like to meet with Duchess Volkina in the palace.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Yes, sir.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: And tell Witte—
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: —Your Imperial Majesty!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: You are not on duty today, Saveliy. Who permitted you to run amok in the Amber Palace like this?
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: I will take him away, sir. I assure you that this will not happen again.
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: ...Hand him to the Third Bureau. I don't want to see him in here again.
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Do with me as you will, sir, but pray listen to me!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: The Fourth Army has left their positions and is proceeding towards Zelgrad!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: What did you say?
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: Insolence! Who instructed you to spread such alarmist talk, when not even the Chairman has confirmed the news?
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: I didn't believe it at first either, but it's the truth!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: I was simply helping to keep an eye on things... I never expected such a thing would happen!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: They have crossed the Second Army's lines unscathed! I never thought this would happen!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: They crossed the lines without engaging in combat? Do you mean—
attributes.name: Respectful Servant

attributes.content: The Second Army...
attributes.name: Fyodor

attributes.content: The Second Army has gone over to the traitors, sir!
attributes.name: Panicking Servant

attributes.content: ...Evgeny Andrianov.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You never meant for Sechin to take that weapon from Zelgrad, did you?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We're cannon fodder for you to determine the Second Army's cooperation. The other unit that you were talking about is your main force.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You've gambled everything on something that you hardly know anything about. You're out of your mind.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Pushing all of one's chips in is only madness when the outcome is yet uncertain. I forgive you for failing to understand.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: But I'm not negotiating with you. There's no need for me to beat around the bush, now that you've finally realized what's happening.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: This is the last time I tolerate your probing. Lieutenant Sirka will not be harmed before you fulfill your duties.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: Make yourselves useful while you still have value as a diversion, so that I might yet deign to recycle you.
attributes.name: Evgeny

attributes.content: But if you continue on your leisurely pace, you can expect to be left by the roadside when my flagship catches up to the Volnov and crushes you like an ant.
attributes.name: Evgeny
